messages.text: Tell me about the Harlo B30 — price, hashrate, and when it ships.

The Harlo B30 is $899, with a hashrate of about 30 TH/s (SHA-256, Bitcoin mining), pulling roughly 360–450W. It's in stock now and ships right away — comes with the power cord and built-in power supply, plug matched to your region. Quiet for a home rig too, around 50 dB. Want me to add one to your cart?
